ironbound_ui_section_overview_blurb: Status of Ironbound in this session, with the settings you will change most.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_window_blurb: The key that opens this window, and the size of Ironbound panels.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_blurb: Keep Valheim's HUD or switch to the Ironbound HUD. Each part has its own page below.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_chestpreview_bl: A compact view of accessible chest contents under your crosshair. Position and size are personal settings.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_hotbar_blurb: An eight-slot Ironbound action bar. Adjust its scale, position, slot spacing and panel padding; vanilla HUD keeps Valheim's original hotbar.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_plant: Plant health, harvest readiness and estimated growth time in the hover text, with either HUD style.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_weapondial_blur: Hold a key, aim at a weapon or tool with the mouse, let go to take it in hand.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_chest: Search nearby accessible chests and follow a temporary dashed yellow guide to a result.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_vitals_blurb: Health, stamina, eitr and food: what the cluster shows and where it sits.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_keys_blurb: The context key guide for building, combat, inventory and fishing: whether it is shown and where it sits.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_notifications_b: Separate pickup text above vitals, recipe milestones beside the minimap, and general messages.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_compass_blurb: The heading strip at the top centre of the screen.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_minimap_blurb: Day and clock above the minimap; current weather and the next one below it.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_status_blurb: Original status icons: passive equipment and ongoing buffs near your name, harmful effects below the compass.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_inventory_blurb: The Ironbound inventory grid and item card, or Valheim's own.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_provi: The provision slots in the HUD, and the keys that eat or drink from them.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_crafting_blurb: The crafting panel: Ironbound style with search and category filters, or Valheim's.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_compendium_blur: Valheim's texts dialog as a Ironbound screen: chapters, entries and an art panel.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_skills_blurb: Valheim's skills dialog as a Ironbound screen: every skill, its level, progress and bonus.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_trophies_blurb: Valheim's trophy wall as a Ironbound screen: every trophy, the ones you have taken lit.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_achievements_bl: Valheim's achievements as a Ironbound screen: every badge, the chosen one's conditions.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_inven: How the Sort buttons lay out your inventory: by name, by type or by weight.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_quick: What the Quick Stack button leaves in your inventory when it fills nearby chests.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_delet: Destroy the item held on the cursor with the inventory's Delete button.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_nearb: Craft, build, supply stations, stack items and search nearby chests with one shared range.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_blurb: Equipment rules, balance modifiers and server authority.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_blurb: Convenience features for storage, inventory, crafting and interaction.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_equipment_: Character slots and additional utility equipment.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_death: Restore worn equipment when reclaiming your tombstone.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_craft: Search and filter the vanilla crafting list.
ironbound_ui_section_qualityoflife_weapo: Enable the radial selector and choose its activation key.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_provisions_blur: Show provision slots on the HUD.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_character_blurb: Character identity, food and visible companions.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_power_blurb: Placement and appearance of the power seal.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_forsakenpo: How long powers last and how soon you can activate them again. Changes apply on the next activation.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_harvesting: Multiply plant and honey harvests. Normal pickup and inventory limits still apply.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_death_blur: Adjust normal skill loss on death: negative values reduce it; -100 removes it.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_skills_blu: Adjust XP earned by all skills. Positive percentages increase gain; negative percentages reduce it.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_resourceco: Separate percentage modifiers for running, attacks, jumps and weapon eitr costs.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_sailing_bl: Forward and reverse propulsion, rudder response, steering strength and water-impact damage.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_ballista_b: Player targeting, ammunition, firing rate, rotation, detection range and bolt behavior.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_smelter_bl: Coal capacity, ore queue and production speed.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_blastfurna: Coal capacity, ore queue and production speed.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_charcoalki: Wood queue and charcoal production speed.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_windmill_b: Barley queue and milling speed. Wind still affects output.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_eitrrefine: Fuel capacity, input queue and refining speed.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_sapextract: Sap storage and extraction speed. The root must still have sap.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_beehive_bl: Honey storage and production speed. Harvest yield is controlled separately.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_fermenter_: Fermentation speed. One batch at a time, with the normal yield.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_oven_blurb: Fuel capacity and cooking speed for fueled cooking stations.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_cookingsta: Cooking speed for fire-heated cooking stations. Faster cooking also means faster burning.
ironbound_ui_section_gameplay_server_blu: When you host or run a server: whether players who join play with your gameplay settings.
ironbound_ui_section_hud_development_blu: Tools for testing live changes while the game runs.
ironbound_ui_config_note: Changes apply instantly and are saved to the config file.
ironbound_ui_config_capture: Press the new key combination. Escape cancels.
ironbound_ui_config_help: {0} or Escape closes this window.  Hover a setting for details.
ironbound_ui_config_hud_optin: Opt in below or on the HUD page
ironbound_ui_search_start: Type an item name to search nearby chests
ironbound_ui_search_empty: No matching items in accessible chests
ironbound_ui_search_many: Nearest {0} of {1} matches · refine your search
ironbound_ui_search_help: ↑ ↓ Select   Enter Locate   Esc Close · guide lasts 20 seconds
ironbound_ui_setting_hud_window_gamepadb: Optional controller button to toggle settings. Unassigned by default; choose a button not used by your other mods.
ironbound_ui_setting_qualityoflife_weapo: Hold to open the weapon dial, aim with the right stick and release to select. Unassigned by default.
ironbound_ui_setting_qualityoflife_nearb: Mark the selected chest-search result for the existing 20-second guide. Respects exploration, access and server range limits. Local display only.
ironbound_ui_setting_hud_minimap_tamedan: Show yellow dots for loaded, living tamed animals in explored areas. Animals are shared; dots disappear when they die or unload. Local display only.
ironbound_ui_setting_hud_crosshairammo_d: Show the selected arrow or bolt icon and carried count below the crosshair when a bow or crossbow is equipped. Includes quiver stacks. Local display only.
ironbound_ui_combat_description: Attacks, damage or enemy attention block mount summoning. The countdown shows the remaining quiet time; your mount must also be out of combat.
